description: Election Commission - Names and addresses of the Election Agents.
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about the 2024 Presidential Election in Sri Lanka. It contains the official notice of election agents appointed for candidates, including their names, addresses, and assigned symbols. The content falls under electoral processes and related matters, specifically covering candidate nominations and agent appointments as outlined in the Presidential Elections Act. This fits perfectly within the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) which includes election announcements, candidate nominations, and electoral commission decisions.
